# HAX art

> Art and media from the HAX project, browsed with HAX.

HAXcms is a file-based CMS: authored pages and metadata are stored as portable files, not locked into a database-only workflow.
The canonical site structure is `site.json`, represented in JSON Outline Schema (`id`, `parent`, `order`, `slug`, `location`, and `metadata`).
Use HAX CLI and ecosystem tooling to maintain human-authored content while keeping machine-readable outputs synchronized.
Managed files (feeds, search indexes, manifests, and this `llms.txt`) are generated artifacts and should be rebuilt by tooling.

## Core resources
- [site.json](https://art.hax.cloud/site.json): Canonical site manifest and navigation tree in JSON Outline Schema format.
- [llms.txt](https://art.hax.cloud/llms.txt): LLM-oriented guide to this site and its machine-readable resources.
- [llms-full.txt](https://art.hax.cloud/llms-full.txt): The whole site as one markdown document, in outline order.
- [Whole site as HTML](https://art.hax.cloud/x/api/v1/site/export/html): Every page in one HTML document.
- [AGENTS.md](https://art.hax.cloud/AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI agents working on this site's files.

## Pages
- [HAX art](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/home/index.md): Art and media from the HAX project, browsed with HAX.
- [Android portrait](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/future-traveler-01/index.md): Red android-style face with glowing cyan goggles, a HAX band across the brow and a gold lightbulb on the forehead.
- [Today](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/era-now/index.md): The Future Traveler icon as it ships: a red dome helmet with HAX in white, a green goggle band with two cyan lenses, and a pale lightbulb on a short stalk above.
- [RPG Glitch](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/rpg-glitch/index.md): The rpg-character on an 80s CRT, glitching between versions of itself. Click for a new character with a costume, pet, mood and pose from the element's wardrobe. Every character gets a link and a HAX embed code.
- [HAX the Web sticker](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-the-web-sticker/index.md): Die-cut sticker: the h-a-x THE WEB wordmark in chunky black pixel letters between pixel curly braces, with a white border.
- [1880s steam age](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1880s/index.md): Sepia Victorian engraving-style poster: "The Grand & Marvellous HAX, Open Source Authoring Engine" with brass gears, a human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb forming Humans + Agents = Experience, above seven stone pillars labeled with the HAX pillars on a Ubiquity base.
- [HAX in under a minute](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-in-a-minute/index.md): A one-minute doodle explainer of HAX.
- [Future Traveler](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/future-traveler/index.md): HAX's mascot, a red-helmeted time traveler, in every style.

- [HAX Morph](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-morph/index.md): HAX decays into Headless Authoring Experience, back to HAX, then into Human, Agent, Experience. Every transition breaks down into pixel blocks and bit noise, with rpg-characters thrown into the static.

- [1900s modern marvel](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1900s/index.md): Cream Art Nouveau poster: "HAX, a Modern Marvel of the New Century" with a human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb, a Headless Authoring Experience ribbon and seven pillars on a Ubiquity base.
- [HAX The Web opening titles](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-the-web-intro/index.md): A 30-second neon title sequence. Credits tell the HAX story from a napkin in 2015 to hundreds of courses while red neon letters drift by, then lock into the HAX / THE / WEB mark. Play, pause, scrub, or read every credit as text.
- [Future Traveler across time](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/future-traveler-eras/index.md): The Future Traveler icon drawn the way each era would have drawn it.
- [1900s modern marvel](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/era-nouveau/index.md): The Future Traveler in art nouveau style: a teal helmet outlined in cream with a serif HAX, gold lenses, and gold whiplash curves rising at both sides.
- [1920s roaring twenties](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/era-deco/index.md): The Future Traveler in art deco style: a black helmet lined in gold with a gold HAX, gold lenses and a gold sunburst fanning out behind him.

- [1980s cyberpunk](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/era-neon/index.md): The Future Traveler as a neon sign: a pink tube outline of the helmet and HAX, cyan goggle rings and a yellow bulb ring, each with a soft glow.

- [32-bit polygons](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/era-polygon/index.md): The Future Traveler in 32-bit style: a helmet of flat-shaded red polygons, teal faceted goggles and a faceted yellow bulb.

- [HAX the Web](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-the-web-game/index.md): A 16-bit title screen and speed run. Race an rpg-character through the web, jumping into glowing badges that each teach one piece of HAX, then read the run report.
- [Logo explorations](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/logo-explorations/index.md): Sheet of HAX logo sketches: the letters H, A and X stacked as black pixel blocks in several arrangements, some with THE and WEB tucked in.
- [1920s roaring twenties](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1920s/index.md): Black and gold Art Deco poster: "The Cat's Pajamas presents HAX, Humans + Agents = Amazing Experience" with seven gold-lined pillars on Ubiquity and the line "Humans lead. Agents help. Ideas ship."
- [Episode XXVI: Return of the Open Web](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/episode-xxvi/index.md): A space-opera opening crawl that catches people up on HAX: where it came from, the web standards it stands on, and where it is in 2026. It ends on a Join the Rebellion card. Viewers with reduced motion get a static, readable version.
- [rpg-character](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/rpg-character/index.md): Games and toys starring HAX's remixable pixel character.
- [WANTED: HAX](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/wanted-poster/index.md): An old-west wanted poster for the Open Web Outlaw, starring the rpg-character in its cowboy hat. The reward is $0, because the source is already free for anyone who forks it.
- [HAX of the Web](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-of-the-web/index.md): A Halloween arcade title screen starring the rpg-character's zombie pirate girl (the element's zpg seed). Type cheat codes, ask Merlin, or press start to drop into a real HAXcms site and edit it.
- [Future Traveler badge](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/future-traveler-badge/index.md): Circular badge: the Future Traveler in a red HAX helmet and cyan goggles peeking over his arms in front of a red and white starburst, lightbulb glowing.
- [1970s rainbow](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1970s/index.md): Warm 1970s poster with a rainbow arch over chunky HAX lettering, three circular badges for humans, agents and experience, and seven striped pillars on Ubiquity. Tagline: "Every era had its tools. This one's yours."
- [HAX by the numbers](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/by-the-numbers/index.md): HAX by the numbers, 2015 to 2025: six colored icons with counts, including 675, 53, 29, 44, 247, 567, 67,515 and 14.
- [RPG me](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/rpg-me/index.md): Make the character that is you across HAX, in a stand-alone tool at rpg.art.hax.cloud.
- [Helmet mark](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/helmet-mark/index.md): The Future Traveler's red HAX helmet and glowing cyan goggles peeking over folded arms, on white.
- [1980s corporate (Paul Rand homage)](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1980s/index.md): Striped black-and-white 1980s corporate poster riffing on Paul Rand: pixel human, Future Traveler and lightbulb above striped HAX letters, with seven striped pillars on Ubiquity.
- [HAX history](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-history/index.md): Dense timeline of HAX history on a black background, with many small yellow lightbulb markers and labeled icons along a horizontal line.
- [Brand](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/brand/index.md): Logos, stickers, banners and posters.
- [Pattern banner](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/pattern-banner/index.md): Wide gray banner of hexagons scattered with small pixel icons: hats, lightning bolts, molecules and tiny characters.
- [h-a-x THE WEB-INAR banner](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/web-inar-banner/index.md): Event banner: h-a-x THE WEB-INAR in white pixel letters between pixel braces on a dark hexagon pattern.
- [HAX Camp poster](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/hax-camp-poster/index.md): HAX Camp event poster with the h-a-x THE WEB wordmark over a photo of a stone university tower, followed by event details.
- [Contribute flyer](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/contribute-flyer/index.md): Dark flyer titled Contribute to HAX the Web, explaining what HAX is, common use cases, the project in action and how to contribute, with QR codes.
- [Video thumbnails](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/video-thumbnails/index.md): Video thumbnail: HAX THE WEB ADVENTURE in bold red, white and purple letters over a black and white photo, with a red starburst badge.
- [1980s cyberpunk](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1980s-cyberpunk/index.md): Neon pink and cyan cyberpunk poster on a dark grid: glowing HAX, Humans + Agents = Experience in neon frames and seven neon pillars on Ubiquity.
- [Legend](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/legend/index.md): Legend for the HAX diagrams on black: icons for developers, projects and end users, each with its role.
- [Posters](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/posters/index.md): The HAX campus and social campaign: posters across time, console homages, the Quest and the World of Tomorrow.
- [1990s early web](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-1990s/index.md): Early-web style poster with rainbow WordArt-like HAX, a Windows-style dialog showing Humans + Agents = Experience, a Headless Authoring Experience banner, seven pillars and a "Ubiquity 100%" progress bar.
- [Game Boy](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-gameboy/index.md): Four-shade green handheld-console poster: HAX in pixel type, "Open Source, Est. 2017", humans + agents = experience sprites and seven pixel pillars on Ubiquity.
- [Game Boy Advance](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-gba/index.md): Bright handheld-console poster in pink, blue and green pixel type with humans + agents = experience sprites and seven colored pillars on Ubiquity.
- [PlayStation](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-ps/index.md): Pale grey 32-bit console poster: chunky 3D HAX letters in red, teal and green, a pixel explorer + the Future Traveler = a lightbulb, and seven 3D colored pillars on Ubiquity. Tagline: "Every era had its tools. This one's yours."
- [Hacker](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-hacker/index.md): Black terminal-style poster with HAX built from ASCII blocks, a hooded human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb, and glitching ASCII pillars on Ubiquity.
- [HAX Quest](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-quest/index.md): Green Game Boy-style RPG battle: the Future Traveler casts the seven pillars as spells at THE VOID, a dark cloud saying "Nothing matters." Menu: Learn, Build, Remix, Grow, with Run and Hide crossed out. QR code to hax.psu.edu.
- [HAX Quest comic](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-quest-comic/index.md): "The Quest: Future Traveler vs the Void" as four Game Boy-style battle panels, ending with "Create your future!" and a QR code.
- [You made it to the future](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-now/index.md): Starry 8-bit poster: "STOP: NOW. You made it to the future." Humans + Agents = Amazing Experience, seven pillars on Ubiquity, "Start building." and a QR code.
- [World of Tomorrow: UBIQUITY](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-tomorrow-all/index.md): 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted in all seven pillar colors. Title "UBIQUITY", tagline "The home of the future, now!", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.

- [Bulletin board](https://art.hax.cloud/pages/poster-bulletin-board/index.md): A campus bulletin board covered in the HAX posters, some peeling, under the banner "HAX: Take one. Skill up. Build the future." Pixel students reach up to read them; the Void looms on the left and a bright future city glows on the right, where the Future Traveler waits.

## Optional
- [Search index](https://art.hax.cloud/lunrSearchIndex.json): Lunr corpus for quick full-text retrieval.
- [RSS feed](https://art.hax.cloud/rss.xml): Site updates in RSS format.
- [Atom feed](https://art.hax.cloud/atom.xml): Site updates in Atom format.
- [Sitemap](https://art.hax.cloud/sitemap.xml): URL-level discovery map for the published site.
- [Agent skills](https://art.hax.cloud/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills discovery index (agentskills.io v0.2.0) listing skills that teach an agent how to read, author, audit, and remix this site.
- [HAX skill catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haxtheweb/praw/stable/skills/index.json): Every HAX agent skill, maintained in PRAW; fetch skills this site does not ship from here.
